newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors, Asia Motors hit new yr lows.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors, Asia Motors hit new yr lows.

text.p: Shares in Kia Motors and Asia Motors hit year lows at Thursday's opening on continuing worries about financial troubles, brokers said.
Kia Group, the nation's eighth largest conglomerate, has strongly denied it was in any trouble, but the rumours persist.

Asia Motors dropped by its lower daily limit of 340 won, or 7.78 percent, to 4,030 at the start of trading. It was the most heavily traded stock with 873,090 shares changing hands. Kia Motors also went limit down, losing 1,100 won to 13,100.

Despite the group's strong denial, fears of financial problems in Kia Group have been kept alive in the market since its commercial vehicle affiliate Asia Motors acknowledged making a late debt payment on Monday.
"Many investors don't believe Kia Group will default on any debts but they are trying to unload their holdings," said a Tongyang Securities broker.
